a1.label: 1. The infrastructure team looks after...
a1.why: The text says the infrastructure team looks after servers, network and hardware.

a2.label: 2. Anna's job is...
a2.why: The text names Anna as the system administrator.

a3.label: 3. The helpdesk opens at 7:30 because...
a3.why: The text says the helpdesk opens early because many colleagues in production start early.

a4.label: 4. During their first year, apprentices...
a4.why: The text says apprentices rotate through all three teams in their first year.

a5.label: 5. New apprentices start in...
a5.why: The text says apprentices start with the support team.

a6.label: 6. On Fridays, the apprentice should ask...
a6.why: The text says to ask Anna for help on Fridays, when Denis doesn't work.

b1.label: 1. The IT ___ is responsible for all computers
b1.why: The IT department is responsible for all computers in the company.

b2.label: 2. Manages servers and installs updates
b2.why: A system administrator manages servers and installs updates.

b3.label: 3. Call this if your laptop stops working
b3.why: You call the helpdesk if your laptop stops working.

b4.label: 4. Monitors, keyboards and printers
b4.why: Monitors, keyboards and printers are examples of hardware.

b5.label: 5. Programs and operating systems
b5.why: Programs and operating systems are called software.

b6.label: 6. New employees get a ___ with username/password
b6.why: Every new employee gets a user account with a username and password.

b7.label: 7. The support team works in two ___
b7.why: The support team works in two shifts: early and late.

c1.label: 1. Anna ___ user accounts
c1.why: He/she in the simple present adds ‘-s’: Anna manages.

c2.label: 2. The helpdesk ___ at 7:30
c2.why: A singular subject in the simple present adds ‘-s’: opens.

c3.label: 3. Denis ___ work on Fridays
c3.why: Simple present negatives for he/she use ‘doesn't’.

c4.label: 4. ___ the developers work flexible hours?
c4.why: ‘Developers’ is plural, so the question uses ‘Do’, not ‘Does’.

c5.label: 5. The team meeting ___ place every Monday
c5.why: A singular subject in the simple present adds ‘-s’: takes.

c6.label: 6. Where ___ your mentor sit?
c6.why: Simple present questions for he/she use ‘does’.

c7.label: 7. Apprentices ___ through all three teams
c7.why: ‘Apprentices’ is plural, so it takes the base form ‘rotate’.
